### Subject Yourselves
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/subject-yourselves
Passage: 1 Peter 2:13-14
Points:
- Believers are called to live holy, honorable lives before a watching world.
- Submitting to governing authorities is an act of obedience rendered for the Lord's sake.
- God institutes civil rulers to uphold order by curbing wrongdoing and rewarding good conduct.
- Refusing to comply with authorities is justified only when they command believers to sin.
- Christians should guard against unlawful rebellion and respect just laws even when inconvenient.

### Respecting Your In-Laws When They Don't Respect You - Crosswalk Couples Devotional - July 17
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/respecting-your-in-laws-when-they-dont-respect-you.html
Passage: 1 Peter 2:17
Points:
- Peter instructs believers to show honor and proper respect to everyone without exception.
- When mistreated by others, Christians are commanded not to retaliate or return evil for evil.
- Showing dignity to difficult individuals honors God, who created every human being in His image.
- Depending on the Holy Spirit enables believers to extend patience and blessing during hardship.
- Choosing gracious behavior reflects the character of Christ and helps silence unfair criticism.
